pr_title: fix(content-manager): send locale when deleting i18n single type
pr_body:

### What does it do?

Send locale for DELETE requests to i18n singleTypes

### Why is it needed?

We don't send an id for single types DELETE requests so every delete request was deleting the default locale as we were only specifying the single type UID

### How to test it?

- Create multiple locales of an i18n single type
- Delete a non default locale from the CM edit view
- Verify it has deleting the correct entry

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

Fixes https://github.com/strapi/strapi/issues/19559
CONTENT-2281

## Bug report

### Required System information

<!-- Please ensure you are using the Node LTS version (v18 or v20) -->
<!-- Strapi v3 is no longer supported, please update to Strapi v4 -->
<!-- If you are reporting a frontend bug please provide error logs after setting STRAPI_ENFORCE_SOURCEMAPS=true in your .env -->

- Node.js version: 18.18.2 / 20.11.1
- NPM version: npm 10.2.4 / yarn 1.22.19
- Strapi version: 4.20.1
- Database: sqlite
- Operating system: MacOS Sonoma
- Is your project Javascript or Typescript: Javascript

<!-- Did you know you can run `yarn strapi report` or `npm run strapi report` to get this information easier? -->

### Describe the bug

When using i18n for a single page it will always default to delete the default locale entry.
So if you have a `Single Type` with 3 languages, you delete any of them it will always delete the default one.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

1. Create a strapi project `npx create-strapi-app@latest i18n-bug`
2. Create multiple locale's (in this test we have english, french, Northen Kurdish _note: the language doesn't matter_ but we are setting **english to default.**

3. Create a `Single Type`
4. Create a field any field is fine

5. Use the `Content Manager` and create some content, for for each language.
6. **Delete** a non-default language
7. It has now deleted the default language, and swapping back to the one you deleted that one already exists.

### Expected behavior

It should delete the correct locale entry, and not the default one.
